name: gizza-ai/xsalsa20-cipher
summary: Encrypt or decrypt data with XSalsa20 using a 32-byte key and 24-byte nonce

tool.description: Encrypt or decrypt UTF-8 data with XSalsa20, the extended-nonce Salsa20 stream cipher. The key must be exactly 32 bytes and nonce exactly 24 bytes. Never reuse a key+nonce pair.
